items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.8 Flash as its most intelligent workhorse model, claiming gains over 3.7 Flash on long-horizon software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning, at the same introductory price of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens. It also launched Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber for vulnerability discovery and automated patching, gated to trusted defenders through the new Fairwind Program. Sundar Pichai said it is the third Flash release in six weeks and cited 86.2% on CyberGym plus 2.6× more correct Chrome security patches than larger commercial models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 為目前最聰明的工作馬模型，稱在長程軟體工程、代理任務與多步推理上優於 3.7 Flash，導入價維持每百萬 tokens $0.75／$3.75。同步推出專攻漏洞發現與自動修補的 3.8 Flash Cyber，經新 Fairwind Program 提供給受信任防禦方。Sundar Pichai 表示這是六週內第三次 Flash 釋出，並稱 CyberGym 達 86.2%、Chrome 安全修補正確數為較大商業模型的 2.6 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cadence-and-cost strategy is the point: Google is iterating Flash faster than flagship Pro drops, and pairing a public workhorse with a restricted cyber variant. Independent confirmation of DeepSWE and CyberGym claims is still pending; Fairwind access, not the public API, is what determines whether 3.8 Flash Cyber actually changes defender workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點在節奏與成本：Google 用 Flash 連發補上旗艦 Pro 空窗，並把最強網路能力鎖在 Fairwind。DeepSWE、CyberGym 數據仍待獨立複核；真正改變防禦作業的是誰拿得到 Cyber，而非公開 API。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re introducing a new 3.8 Flash model, our 3rd Flash release in just 6 wks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出新的 3.8 Flash 模型，這是短短六週內的第三次 Flash 釋出。

items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 十天後推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Grok 4.7 “comes out in 10 days,” implying a target around September 12, after Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke praised Grok 4.6. He did not publish a lab blog, system card, or benchmarks with the post. Press recaps of earlier Musk comments describe a larger ~2.1T pretrain and supplemental SpaceX engineering data, but those details were not restated in the September 2 post.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文寫「Grok 4.7 comes out in 10 days」，對應約 9 月 12 日，是在 Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke 稱讚 Grok 4.6 之後。該則貼文未附實驗室部落格、系統卡或基準。先前言論曾提到約 2.1T 預訓練與 SpaceX 工程資料補訓，但 9 月 2 日這則貼文本身並未重述。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a dated teaser, not a release. Whether 4.7 actually lands on that day, and how it compares with Gemini 3.8 Flash or Claude Fable 5.1, remains unverified until official evaluations ship.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是有日期的預告，不是上市。能否準時出、與 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Fable 5.1 如何比較，都要等官方評測，不能把預告當成成績。

items_flat.title_en: Claude can use a Mac in the background in Cowork and Claude Code
items_flat.title_zh: Claude 可在 Cowork 與 Claude Code 背景操作電腦
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s @claudeai account said Claude can now use a computer in the background inside Claude Cowork and Claude Code: it clicks, types, and opens apps while the user works on something else. The feature is in beta on Pro and Max plans in the macOS desktop app; users turn it on under Settings → General → Computer use. The post pointed to Anthropic support docs on how the mode works and how to use it safely.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方帳號 @claudeai 宣布，Claude 現可在 Claude Cowork 與 Claude Code 於背景操作電腦：點擊、打字、開啟應用，同時使用者做別的事。功能為 Pro／Max 方案 beta，僅 macOS 桌面版，需在設定 → 一般 → Computer use 開啟。貼文連到安全使用說明。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-surface expansion of computer use, not a new model. The practical change is unattended desktop agency on a Mac; reliability, permission scope, and misuse risk are still defined by the support article rather than a new system card.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是電腦操作能力的產品化，不是新模型。實質變化是 Mac 上可無人值守代操；穩定性、權限範圍與濫用風險仍以說明文件為準，尚未見到新系統卡。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now use your computer in the background in Claude Cowork and Claude Code.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 現在可以在 Claude Cowork 與 Claude Code 於背景使用你的電腦。

items_flat.summary_en: The Grok Bot account posted that Grok Bot is now available on Android. Elon Musk quoted the post with “Grok @Bot now on Android!” and separately highlighted an example of a Bot identifying an X API issue, notifying the user when it was fixed, and continuing the project.
items_flat.summary_zh: Grok Bot 帳號宣布現已可在 Android 使用。Elon Musk 轉貼並寫「Grok @Bot now on Android!」，另舉例 Bot 能找出 X API 問題、修好後通知使用者並繼續專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a client rollout for an existing agent product, not a new foundation model. It widens where persistent Grok agents can run; capability claims still rest on the prior Bot stack rather than a fresh eval drop.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有代理產品的客戶端擴充，不是新基礎模型。意義在於常駐 Grok 代理能跑在更多裝置上；能力本身仍取決於既有 Bot 堆疊，而非新一輪評測。

brief_zh: Google推Gemini 3.8 Flash與防禦版Cyber；馬斯克稱Grok 4.7約十天後上線；Claude可背景操電腦；Grok Bot登陸Android。
